classification.difficultyReason: Combine a vertically opposite angle and a subdivided straight angle to form equations for two unknowns.

spec.description: Three concurrent straight lines with six unlettered rays. Preserve 42°, 12°, y° and 2x − 12°. Separate sector arcs implement the inventory's enlarged-source interpretation.
spec.mathematics: The northeast-to-shallow-east sector is vertically opposite 42°. The northwest-to-northeast sector, 42° and 12° partition a straight angle.

answer.worked:
Vertically opposite angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}2x-12&=42\\2x&=54\\x&=27\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}y+42^\circ+12^\circ&=180^\circ\\y+54^\circ&=180^\circ\\y&=126^\circ\end{align*}$$
